fields.name: remaining_moves
fields.description: An ordered list of menu letters for the demonstrated target-to-target moves not yet completed in execution, including the move to command at this decision step. Extract one move per demonstrated transition between neighboring targets; preserve consecutive identical moves and ignore pauses, image jitter, and the reset from demonstration to execution. At the first decision step store the complete list. At each subsequent decision step remove the one move completed since the preceding decision. Do not remove the move being selected at the current step. Episode 3 values at steps 1–4 are ["E","D","G","H"], ["D","G","H"], ["G","H"], ["H"]. Episode 10 values are ["A","H","H"], ["H","H"], ["H"]. Episode 34 values are ["A","H","D","F"], ["H","D","F"], ["D","F"], ["F"]. Episode 97 values are ["B","H","A"], ["H","A"], ["A"]. Episode 99 values are ["D","G","B","D"], ["G","B","D"], ["B","D"], ["D"]. e.g. ["E","D","G","H"]
